description: Hearty overnight-style oats cooked with ripe banana, topped with seeds and honey.
instructions:
1. Add 1/2 cup oats to saucepan with 1.5 cups milk.
2. Cook on medium heat, stirring 5-7 min.
3. Mash 1 ripe banana, stir into oats.
4. Add cinnamon, vanilla, pinch of salt.
5. Remove from heat, let thicken 2 min.
6. Top with sliced banana, chia seeds, honey.
7. Add chopped walnuts for crunch.

description: High-satiety breakfast with whole wheat toast, creamy PB, banana slices, and chia seeds.
instructions:
1. Toast 2 slices whole wheat bread till golden.
2. Spread 1.5 tbsp natural peanut butter on each.
3. Slice 1 banana into rounds.
4. Arrange banana slices on toast.
5. Drizzle 1 tsp honey.
6. Sprinkle chia seeds and a pinch of cinnamon.
7. Serve immediately.

description: Light, aromatic flattened rice cooked with vegetables, mustard, and turmeric.
instructions:
1. Rinse 1.5 cups thick poha, drain, rest 5 min.
2. Heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves.
3. Add onion, green chili, saute 3 min.
4. Add peas, carrot, cook 4 min.
5. Add turmeric, salt, sugar — mix.
6. Add soaked poha, toss gently.
7. Cook 3 min, squeeze lemon, garnish coriander.

description: Savory moong dal crepes packed with protein — an Indian superfood breakfast.
instructions:
1. Soak 1 cup moong dal 4 hours, drain.
2. Grind to smooth batter with ginger, green chili.
3. Add chopped onion, coriander, salt, ajwain.
4. Heat non-stick pan, lightly oil.
5. Pour ladle of batter, spread thin circle.
6. Add finely chopped veggies on top.
7. Cook 3 min each side till golden crisp.

description: Elegant parfait with protein-rich yogurt, fresh fruits, granola, and honey.
instructions:
1. Take 200g thick Greek yogurt in a tall glass.
2. Add 2 tbsp crunchy granola as base layer.
3. Add mixed berries: strawberry, blueberry, raspberry.
4. Repeat yogurt-granola-fruit layers.
5. Drizzle 1 tsp raw honey on top.
6. Add 5-6 mint leaves for freshness.
7. Dust with cinnamon, serve immediately.

description: Soft steamed rice cakes with spiced vegetable lentil soup — South India classic.
instructions:
1. Ferment idli batter overnight (or use store-bought).
2. Grease idli molds, pour batter, steam 12-15 min.
3. For sambar: pressure cook toor dal with tomato, turmeric.
4. Saute onion, drumstick, brinjal in oil.
5. Add tamarind water, sambar powder, cooked dal.
6. Temper with mustard, curry leaves, dried red chili.
7. Serve hot idlis with sambar and coconut chutney.

description: South Indian semolina porridge with vegetables, mustard seeds, and curry leaves.
instructions:
1. Dry roast 1 cup fine rava (semolina) till light golden.
2. Heat oil, add mustard, urad dal, curry leaves.
3. Add onion, ginger, green chili — saute 3 min.
4. Add carrot, peas, beans — cook 5 min.
5. Add 2.5 cups boiling water, salt.
6. Slowly pour roasted rava, stir constantly.
7. Cover and cook 5 min, serve with coconut chutney.

description: Naturally sweet gluten-friendly pancakes with banana, oats, and eggs.
instructions:
1. Mash 2 very ripe bananas in a bowl until smooth.
2. Add 1 cup oats blended to flour.
3. Add 2 eggs, vanilla, pinch of cinnamon.
4. Mix till batter forms — it will be thick.
5. Pour small rounds on greased non-stick pan.
6. Cook on medium 2-3 min, flip carefully.
7. Stack and serve with berries and maple syrup.

description: Bold, flavourful egg-free omelette made from chickpea flour with Indian spices.
instructions:
1. Mix 1 cup besan with water to pancake batter consistency.
2. Add turmeric, chili powder, cumin, salt.
3. Fold in: onion, tomato, green chili, coriander.
4. Heat oil in flat pan.
5. Pour mixture, spread in circle.
6. Cook 3-4 min each side till cooked through.
7. Serve with mint chutney and toast.

description: Trendy nutritious toast with avocado, cherry tomatoes, and chili flakes.
instructions:
1. Toast 2 thick slices sourdough bread.
2. Halve 1 ripe avocado, remove pit.
3. Scoop flesh into bowl, mash with fork.
4. Add lemon juice, salt, black pepper, garlic powder.
5. Spread generously on toast.
6. Top with halved cherry tomatoes.
7. Sprinkle red chili flakes, sesame seeds, drizzle olive oil.

description: Low-calorie high-protein omelette perfect for weight loss and cutting phase.
instructions:
1. Separate 4 large egg whites into clean bowl.
2. Whisk until frothy with salt, pepper, dried herbs.
3. Lightly spray non-stick pan with oil.
4. Pour egg whites, tilt to spread thin.
5. Add spinach, sliced mushroom, bell pepper on one side.
6. Fold omelette over filling.
7. Cook 1 more minute, serve with hot sauce.

description: Simple, satisfying protein-packed breakfast with perfectly boiled eggs.
instructions:
1. Bring water to full boil in saucepan.
2. Gently lower 2-3 eggs, cook 9 min for hard-boiled.
3. Transfer to ice water, peel when cool.
4. Toast 2 slices whole wheat bread.
5. Slice eggs, arrange on toast.
6. Season with salt, pepper, paprika.
7. Add sliced avocado or tomato on the side.

description: Silky, protein-rich scrambled eggs folded with iron-rich spinach.
instructions:
1. Crack 3 eggs into bowl, whisk with 2 tbsp milk.
2. Heat 1 tsp butter in non-stick pan on LOW heat.
3. Add 1 cup fresh spinach, wilt for 1 min.
4. Pour egg mixture over spinach.
5. Stir gently in slow figure-8 motions.
6. Remove from heat while still slightly wet — residual heat finishes them.
7. Season, serve on toast or grain bowl.

description: High-protein breakfast wrap with grilled chicken sausage, egg, and salad.
instructions:
1. Grill 2 chicken sausages till browned all over (8 min).
2. Scramble 1 egg in separate pan with pinch of salt.
3. Warm 1 large whole wheat tortilla on dry pan.
4. Spread 1 tbsp hummus or mustard on tortilla.
5. Add sliced sausage, scrambled egg.
6. Add shredded lettuce, tomato slice, cheese.
7. Roll tight, slice diagonally, serve.

description: Omega-rich tuna on avocado toast — double protein and healthy fat bomb.
instructions:
1. Drain 1 small can tuna in water completely.
2. Mix tuna with 1 tsp lemon juice, salt, herbs.
3. Toast 2 slices sourdough or wheat bread.
4. Mash 1/2 avocado with lemon, salt, black pepper.
5. Spread avocado generously on toast.
6. Pile tuna mixture on top.
7. Add capers, red onion rings, everything bagel seasoning.

description: Simple, satisfying snack with natural sugars, healthy fats, and fiber.
instructions:
1. Core 1 medium apple, slice into 8 wedges.
2. Arrange on plate in fan pattern.
3. Add 1.5 tbsp natural almond or peanut butter.
4. Sprinkle a few raisins or granola.
5. Add pinch of cinnamon on the butter.
6. Optional: drizzle tiny bit of honey.
7. Eat within 30 min for best freshness.

description: Air-popped lotus seeds roasted in ghee — a zero-junk Indian superfood snack.
instructions:
1. Heat 1 tsp ghee in wide pan on low-medium.
2. Add 2 cups makhana, stir continuously.
3. Roast 8-10 min till crispy throughout.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Add salt, chili powder, chaat masala.
6. Toss well, cool completely — they crisp more on cooling.
7. Store airtight, eat within 3 days.

description: Energy-dense mix of nuts and seeds — perfect pre-workout or desk snack.
instructions:
1. Measure: 10 almonds, 8 cashews, 5 walnuts.
2. Add 1 tsp pumpkin seeds, 1 tsp sunflower seeds.
3. Add a few dried cranberries or raisins.
4. Optional: lightly toast in dry pan 3 min for crunch.
5. Season with tiny pinch of himalayan salt.
6. Mix all together in small bowl.
7. Portion into 30g servings for calorie control.

description: Colorful vitamin-rich fruit bowl with a variety of textures.
instructions:
1. Cut seasonal fruits: mango, papaya, watermelon, grapes.
2. Slice banana, add orange segments.
3. Mix together in large bowl.
4. Sprinkle chaat masala and lemon juice (Indian style).
5. Or: add honey and mint for Mediterranean style.
6. Top with pomegranate seeds for antioxidants.
7. Serve chilled.

description: Creamy homemade hummus with roasted garlic and fresh vegetable sticks.
instructions:
1. Drain and rinse 1 can chickpeas.
2. Roast 4 garlic cloves (skins on) at 200°C for 20 min.
3. Squeeze roasted garlic out.
4. Blend chickpeas, roasted garlic, 3 tbsp tahini, lemon juice.
5. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, cumin, salt — blend smooth.
6. Add cold water for desired consistency.
7. Plate with drizzle of olive oil, paprika. Serve with cucumber, carrot, bell pepper sticks.

description: Protein-packed sprouted moong with tangy chutneys and crunchy sev.
instructions:
1. Sprout moong dal 2 days ahead (rinse twice daily).
2. Lightly steam sprouts 2 min to remove rawness.
3. Cool completely.
4. Mix: chopped onion, tomato, cucumber, green chili.
5. Add chaat masala, roasted cumin, lemon juice, salt.
6. Add green chutney and tamarind chutney to taste.
7. Toss well, top with sev, coriander, pomegranate.

description: Tender marinated chicken pieces grilled to perfection — a lean protein snack.
instructions:
1. Cut 200g chicken breast into small cubes.
2. Marinate: yogurt, lemon, ginger-garlic paste, tikka masala, salt.
3. Marinate minimum 2 hours, overnight is best.
4. Skewer on toothpicks or small skewers.
5. Grill on high heat 10-12 min, turning halfway.
6. Should have slight char on outside.
7. Serve with mint chutney and lemon wedge.

description: Nutrition-dense snack that is portable, filling, and supremely high in protein.
instructions:
1. Place eggs in single layer in saucepan.
2. Cover with cold water by 1 inch.
3. Bring to boil over medium-high heat.
4. Once boiling, reduce heat, cook exactly 10 min.
5. Transfer immediately to ice water.
6. Rest 15 min — this makes peeling easy.
7. Peel, slice, season with salt, pepper, paprika.

description: Quick assembly protein snack with omega-3 rich tuna on whole grain crackers.
instructions:
1. Drain 1 small can (85g) tuna in water.
2. Mix tuna with 1 tsp mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper.
3. Add finely chopped celery or cucumber for crunch.
4. Arrange 8-10 whole grain crackers on plate.
5. Top each cracker with tuna mixture.
6. Add sliced cherry tomato on top.
7. Garnish with dill or parsley.

description: Creamy arhar dal tempered with ghee, cumin, garlic, and whole spices.
instructions:
1. Pressure cook 1 cup arhar dal with 3 cups water, turmeric, salt (3 whistles).
2. Mash slightly, adjust consistency with water.
3. Heat ghee in tadka pan on high heat.
4. Add cumin seeds — let them splutter.
5. Add chopped onion, cook till deep golden (8 min).
6. Add ginger-garlic paste, cook 2 min.
7. Add tomatoes, red chili, garam masala — cook 5 min.
8. Pour tadka over dal, stir, garnish coriander.
9. Serve with steamed rice and pickle.

description: Velvety rich tomato-cashew curry with soft paneer cubes — restaurant quality.
instructions:
1. Blend: 4 tomatoes, 10 cashews, 1 onion to smooth paste.
2. Heat butter, add bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon.
3. Pour paste, cook on medium 10-12 min, stirring often.
4. Oil will separate at edges — this is key.
5. Add kashmiri red chili, garam masala, sugar, salt.
6. Add cream, stir, simmer 5 min.
7. Cube 250g paneer, add to gravy.
8. Cook 5 min gently.
9. Add kasuri methi, serve with hot rotis.

description: Kidney beans curry — complete plant-based protein with steamed rice.
instructions:
1. Soak rajma overnight, drain.
2. Pressure cook with fresh water and salt (5-6 whistles).
3. Heat oil, add bay leaf, cumin.
4. Fry onion till brown (8 min), add ginger-garlic.
5. Add tomato puree, all powdered spices — cook till oil leaves.
6. Add boiled rajma with 1 cup water.
7. Simmer 15-20 min till thick, creamy gravy.
8. Mash a few beans against pan side for thickness.
9. Garnish coriander, serve with steamed rice.

description: Iron-rich spinach curry with soft paneer — a complete nutritional powerhouse.
instructions:
1. Blanch 3 cups spinach in boiling water 2 min.
2. Immediately transfer to ice water (preserves green color).
3. Blend spinach to smooth paste.
4. Heat oil, add cumin, chopped onion.
5. Add ginger-garlic paste, cook 3 min.
6. Add tomato, red chili, coriander powder — cook 5 min.
7. Add spinach puree, stir.
8. Add cream, salt, garam masala.
9. Add 200g paneer cubes, cook 5 min gently.

description: Complete amino acid profile in one bowl — inspired by MyFitnessPal power users.
instructions:
1. Rinse 1 cup quinoa thoroughly (removes bitter coating).
2. Cook in 2 cups water with pinch of salt (15 min, let steam 5 min).
3. Toss broccoli, bell pepper, sweet potato in olive oil.
4. Roast vegetables at 200°C for 25 min.
5. Make tahini dressing: tahini, lemon, garlic, water, salt.
6. Layer quinoa in bowl, add roasted veggies.
7. Add 1/4 can chickpeas, sliced avocado.
8. Drizzle dressing generously.
9. Top with pumpkin seeds and herbs.

description: Mexican-inspired tacos with spiced black beans, avocado, and fresh salsa.
instructions:
1. Heat oil in pan, add cumin and garlic.
2. Add 1 can black beans (drained), season chili powder, salt.
3. Mash half the beans roughly for creamy texture.
4. Warm 6 small corn tortillas directly on flame.
5. Make salsa: tomato, onion, coriander, lime, jalapeno.
6. Assemble: beans, shredded purple cabbage, fresh salsa.
7. Top with avocado slices, squeeze of lime.
8. Add hot sauce if desired.

description: Iron-rich spinach with crispy roasted chickpeas and lemon dressing.
instructions:
1. Drain chickpeas, toss with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt.
2. Roast at 200°C for 25-30 min till crispy.
3. Make lemon dressing: lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, honey.
4. In large bowl, toss baby spinach with dressing.
5. Add roasted chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, cucumber.
6. Add kalamata olives, thinly sliced red onion.
7. Crumble feta on top.
8. Add toasted pine nuts or pumpkin seeds.

description: Japanese-inspired protein stir fry with crispy tofu and colourful vegetables.
instructions:
1. Press 400g firm tofu between towels 20 min.
2. Cube and marinate in teriyaki sauce 15 min.
3. Make extra teriyaki: soy sauce, mirin, sake, brown sugar.
4. Heat wok on highest heat with sesame oil.
5. Cook tofu till golden on all 4 sides (8-10 min). Set aside.
6. Stir fry vegetables: broccoli, snap peas, carrot, mushroom.
7. Add tofu back, pour sauce, toss.
8. Serve over steamed jasmine rice.
9. Garnish sesame seeds and spring onion.

recipe_name: Herb Grilled Chicken Brown Rice Bowl
description: Lean protein meets complex carbs — the perfect macro-balanced lunch.
instructions:
1. Pound chicken breast to even thickness.
2. Marinate 30 min: yogurt, lemon, garlic, cumin, herbs, chili.
3. Cook brown rice (35 min) — prep in advance.
4. Grill chicken on HIGH heat 6-7 min each side.
5. Let rest 5 min before slicing — CRUCIAL for juiciness.
6. Slice against grain into strips.
7. Build bowl: rice base, chicken strips, cucumber raita.
8. Add cherry tomatoes, green onion.
9. Drizzle extra lemon.

description: Tangy coconut-based fish curry with kokum — South Indian coastal comfort food.
instructions:
1. Marinate fish: turmeric, salt, chili powder — 15 min.
2. Heat coconut oil in clay pot or deep pan.
3. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves, dried red chilies.
4. Add shallots, ginger, green chili — saute 5 min.
5. Add tomatoes, red chili powder, coriander powder.
6. Add thick coconut milk, piece of kokum, salt.
7. Simmer 5 min till sauce thickens.
8. Add marinated fish pieces.
9. Cook gently 10 min, garnish curry leaves.

description: Omega-3 rich salmon fillet baked with aromatic garlic, herbs, and lemon.
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C, line tray with parchment.
2. Pat salmon dry — important for good crust.
3. Mix: 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 garlic cloves minced, rosemary, thyme, lemon zest.
4. Brush generously on flesh side.
5. Season well with salt and black pepper.
6. Bake 15-18 min — it should flake easily.
7. Squeeze fresh lemon over salmon.
8. Serve with steamed asparagus and quinoa.
9. Garnish capers and fresh dill.

description: High-protein salad with grilled chicken, avocado, and Greek yogurt dressing.
instructions:
1. Season chicken breast with Italian herbs, garlic, salt, pepper.
2. Sear in hot pan 6-7 min each side on medium-high.
3. Rest 5 min, slice thinly against grain.
4. Make dressing: Greek yogurt, lemon, Dijon mustard, garlic, herbs.
5. Toss romaine, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, avocado.
6. Add red onion, corn kernels if desired.
7. Plate salad, arrange chicken strips on top.
8. Drizzle yogurt dressing generously.
9. Top with toasted pumpkin seeds.

description: Complete macro meal with perfect protein-carb-fat ratios in one bowl.
instructions:
1. Cook 1 cup brown rice (40 min) — batch cook ahead.
2. Drain 1 can tuna in water completely.
3. Mix tuna with lemon, dill, celery, salt, pepper.
4. Slice: avocado, cucumber, cherry tomatoes.
5. Build bowl: rice base (1 cup cooked).
6. Add tuna, avocado, veggies arranged by color.
7. Add edamame for extra protein.
8. Make dressing: sesame oil, soy sauce, ginger, honey.
9. Drizzle dressing, top sesame seeds.

description: Detoxifying one-pot dal-rice — Ayurvedic superfood for gut healing.
instructions:
1. Wash 1/2 cup rice and 1/4 cup split moong dal together.
2. Soak 20 min, drain.
3. Pressure cook with 3 cups water, turmeric, salt (3 whistles).
4. Heat ghee, add cumin, asafoetida (hing), ginger.
5. Add vegetables: carrot, peas, green beans.
6. Cook 5 min, add to khichdi.
7. Mix well, add ghee generously.
8. Adjust water for porridge consistency.
9. Serve with yogurt, pickle, and papad.

description: Crispy baked tofu with ginger teriyaki glaze — better than takeout.
instructions:
1. Press tofu 30 min, cube into 2cm pieces.
2. Toss with cornstarch, salt — this creates crispiness.
3. Bake at 200°C for 25 min, flipping halfway.
4. Sauce: soy sauce, mirin, fresh ginger, garlic, sesame oil, honey.
5. Simmer sauce 5 min till slightly thick.
6. Toss crispy tofu in sauce.
7. Serve over rice noodles or cauliflower rice.
8. Garnish sesame seeds, green onion, chili flakes.

description: Spiralized zucchini with vibrant homemade basil pesto — guilt-free pasta night.
instructions:
1. Spiralize 3 medium zucchinis or use vegetable peeler for ribbons.
2. Blend pesto: 2 cups basil, 3 tbsp pine nuts, 2 garlic, parmesan, olive oil.
3. Heat 1 tsp olive oil, add zucchini noodles.
4. Toss quickly on HIGH heat — only 3 min or they go soggy.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Toss with 3-4 tbsp pesto.
7. Add halved cherry tomatoes.
8. Season with salt, cracked pepper.
9. Top with extra parmesan and pine nuts.

description: Light, protein-rich grilled fish — ideal weight-loss dinner.
instructions:
1. Score fish fillet diagonally 3 times on each side.
2. Marinate 20 min: lemon juice, garlic, fresh herbs, olive oil, salt, pepper.
3. Bring fish to room temperature before grilling.
4. Preheat grill or grill pan to high — very hot.
5. Grill 4-5 min each side depending on thickness.
6. Fish is done when it flakes easily with fork.
7. Plate on bed of mixed salad greens.
8. Add lemon wedge and drizzle extra olive oil.
9. Garnish fresh herbs.

description: Complete meal — chicken thighs roasted with vegetables on one baking tray.
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C.
2. Cube vegetables: sweet potato, carrot, broccoli, zucchini, onion.
3. Toss veggies with olive oil, thyme, rosemary, garlic, salt, pepper.
4. Rub chicken thighs with paprika, garlic powder, cumin, salt.
5. Place chicken and veggies on single large baking tray.
6. Bake 40 min, flip veggies halfway.
7. Chicken should be golden with juices running clear.
8. Rest 5 min before serving.
9. Drizzle tray juices over everything.

description: Perfectly cooked ribeye with herb butter — for serious muscle building.
instructions:
1. Remove steak from fridge 30 min before cooking — room temperature is ESSENTIAL.
2. Season VERY generously with coarse salt and black pepper on all sides.
3. Heat cast iron skillet till SMOKING HOT — this creates the sear.
4. Add 1 tbsp oil, place steak, do not touch for 3-4 min.
5. Flip, add 2 tbsp butter, 4 garlic cloves, fresh rosemary, thyme.
6. Tilt pan, continuously spoon herb butter over steak (basting) for 3 min.
7. For medium: internal temp 63°C. For medium-rare: 57°C.
8. REST on wire rack 5-8 min — this is non-negotiable.
9. Slice against grain, serve with roasted potato wedges.

description: Umami-rich miso-glazed salmon — restaurant quality in 30 minutes.
instructions:
1. Mix glaze: 3 tbsp white miso, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sake, 1 tsp brown sugar.
2. Marinate salmon 30 min (up to 4 hours) in glaze.
3. Preheat oven to 220°C with grill/broil setting.
4. Line tray with aluminium foil.
5. Place salmon skin-side down.
6. Broil 10-12 min till caramelized and slightly charred.
7. Watch carefully — miso burns quickly.
8. While salmon cooks, blanch pak choi and green beans.
9. Plate salmon over greens, sprinkle sesame seeds.

description: High-calorie satisfying french toast for weight gain goals.
instructions:
1. Whisk 2 eggs with 3 tbsp whole milk, 1 tsp vanilla, cinnamon.
2. Dip thick (2cm) wheat bread slices in mixture, let soak 30 seconds each side.
3. Melt 1 tbsp butter in pan on medium heat.
4. Cook soaked bread 3-4 min each side till golden.
5. Spread 1.5 tbsp natural peanut butter on each slice.
6. Slice 1 banana, arrange on top.
7. Drizzle pure maple syrup.
8. Add mixed berries on side.
9. Dust with powdered sugar.

description: Italian-inspired pasta with spiced chicken — calorie-dense muscle meal.
instructions:
1. Cook 200g penne or rigatoni al dente in salted water.
2. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
3. Season chicken with Italian herbs, salt, pepper.
4. Sear in hot pan 6 min each side, slice when rested.
5. In same pan: saute garlic in olive oil, add chili flakes.
6. Add 1 can crushed tomatoes, simmer 10 min.
7. Season with salt, sugar, fresh basil.
8. Toss pasta in sauce with pasta water for glossy coating.
9. Plate, top with chicken slices and grated parmesan.

description: Crispy fried bread with spiced chickpea curry — a North Indian indulgence.
instructions:
1. Soak chickpeas overnight, pressure cook till soft.
2. Heat oil, add whole spices: bay leaf, clove, cardamom.
3. Brown onions deeply (12 min), add ginger-garlic.
4. Add tomato puree and all spice powders.
5. Cook till oil separates (8 min).
6. Add chickpeas with 1 cup water, simmer 20 min.
7. For bhature: knead maida with yogurt, oil, salt till smooth.
8. Rest 30 min, roll thick circles.
9. Deep fry in hot oil till puffed and golden.

description: Fragrant long-grain rice cooked with spiced vegetables and whole spices.
instructions:
1. Wash and soak basmati rice 30 min.
2. Fry onions in ghee till deep brown (caramelized).
3. Add whole spices: cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, star anise.
4. Add vegetables: carrot, peas, beans, cauliflower.
5. Add yogurt, biryani masala, salt.
6. Layer half-cooked rice over vegetables.
7. Top with fried onions, saffron milk, ghee, mint.
8. Seal pot with dough or foil (dum cooking).
9. Cook on very low heat 25 min. Rest 10 min before opening.

description: Comforting lentil-vegetable soup mixed with steamed rice.
instructions:
1. Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and water.
2. Saute onion, tomato, drumstick in oil.
3. Add sambar powder, tamarind water, salt.
4. Add cooked dal to vegetables.
5. Temper: mustard, cumin, curry leaves, dried chili.
6. Pour tadka over sambar, simmer 10 min.
7. Cook separate white rice.
8. Mix sambar generously with rice.
9. Serve with papad, pickle, and ghee.

description: Charred roasted eggplant mashed with spices and fresh vegetables.
instructions:
1. Char brinjal directly over flame till completely blackened.
2. Cover in foil, rest 10 min — easier to peel.
3. Peel and mash the soft flesh.
4. Heat oil, add cumin seeds.
5. Add onion, cook till golden.
6. Add ginger-garlic, green chili, cook 2 min.
7. Add tomatoes, all spices, cook 5 min.
8. Add mashed brinjal, mix thoroughly.
9. Garnish coriander, serve with rotis.

description: Light, warming moong dal soup — easy to digest and calorie-conscious.
instructions:
1. Wash 3/4 cup split moong dal.
2. Heat ghee, add cumin, asafoetida.
3. Add ginger, green chili, cook 1 min.
4. Add moong dal, stir 2 min.
5. Add 4 cups water, salt, turmeric.
6. Pressure cook 2 whistles.
7. Add lemon juice, fresh coriander.
8. Adjust consistency — can be thin or thick.
9. Serve hot with rice or as a soup.

description: Low-carb cauliflower rice stir-fried with vegetables and umami sauce.
instructions:
1. Pulse cauliflower florets in food processor to rice size.
2. Heat sesame oil in wok on HIGHEST possible heat.
3. Add minced garlic and ginger, stir 1 min.
4. Add vegetables: peas, carrot, corn, edamame.
5. Add cauliflower rice, toss continuously on high 4-5 min.
6. Push everything aside, crack 2 eggs in center.
7. Scramble eggs, then mix with rice.
8. Season: soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper.
9. Top with green onion, sesame seeds.

description: Calorie-dense bowl with healthy fats, complex carbs for steady energy.
instructions:
1. Cook 1 cup brown rice, cool slightly.
2. Slice 1 ripe avocado into fan shape.
3. Roast cherry tomatoes with olive oil at 180°C for 15 min.
4. Pan-fry 1/2 cup chickpeas with smoked paprika till crispy.
5. Build bowl: warm brown rice.
6. Fan avocado slices, add roasted tomatoes.
7. Add crispy chickpeas, sliced cucumber, corn.
8. Make tahini dressing: tahini, lemon, garlic, water, cumin.
9. Drizzle dressing, top with microgreens and sesame.

description: Vibrant salad with herby avocado dressing and protein-rich chickpeas.
instructions:
1. Make green dressing: blend avocado, basil, garlic, lemon, olive oil, salt.
2. Thin with water to pourable consistency.
3. Drain and rinse 1 can chickpeas, pat dry.
4. Massage 2 cups kale with 1 tsp olive oil and pinch of salt.
5. Add cucumber, green bell pepper, celery, edamame.
6. Add chickpeas and sliced avocado.
7. Pour green dressing over salad.
8. Toss gently, top with hemp seeds.
9. Serve immediately.

description: Rich, aromatic butter chicken — a global favourite.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken 2 hours: yogurt, lemon, spices.
2. Grill or pan-sear till charred on outside.
3. Blend: tomatoes, cashews, onion to smooth sauce.
4. Heat butter, add whole spices.
5. Pour sauce, cook 15 min till rich and thick.
6. Add kashmiri chili, garam masala, kasuri methi.
7. Add cream, stir.
8. Add grilled chicken pieces, simmer 10 min.
9. Serve with butter naan and salad.

description: Boiled eggs in a flavourful tomato-onion gravy — quick protein dinner.
instructions:
1. Hard boil 4-6 eggs, peel.
2. Score eggs with knife for sauce to penetrate.
3. Shallow fry eggs in oil till golden outside — 3 min.
4. In same pan: saute onion till golden.
5. Add ginger-garlic, cook 2 min.
6. Add tomato puree, all spices — cook 8 min.
7. Add 1 cup water, bring to simmer.
8. Add fried eggs, cook 10 min gently.
9. Garnish coriander, serve with rice or roti.

description: Slow-cooked aromatic mutton biryani — a celebratory rice dish.
instructions:
1. Marinate mutton overnight: yogurt, spices, raw papaya.
2. Deep fry onions (birista) till dark brown.
3. Cook mutton on pressure cooker with whole spices.
4. Par-cook basmati rice till 70% done.
5. Layer in heavy pot: mutton, fried onions, mint, saffron milk.
6. Top with rice layer, more onions and saffron.
7. Seal with dough or foil.
8. Dum cook on very low heat 35 min.
9. Rest 15 min, mix gently from bottom.

description: Juicy prawns in spiced tomato-coconut gravy — coastal India comfort.
instructions:
1. Clean and devein 300g large prawns.
2. Marinate with turmeric, salt, chili.
3. Heat coconut oil, add mustard, curry leaves.
4. Add onion, cook till golden.
5. Add ginger-garlic, tomatoes, all spices.
6. Cook till oil separates (8 min).
7. Add 1/2 cup coconut milk.
8. Add prawns, cook 8-10 min — don't overcook.
9. Garnish coriander, serve with rice.

description: Stacked protein sandwich with lean turkey, creamy avocado, and veggies.
instructions:
1. Toast 3 slices whole grain bread.
2. Mash 1/2 avocado with lemon, salt.
3. Spread avocado on bottom slice.
4. Layer: turkey breast slices, romaine.
5. Add second bread, spread mustard.
6. Add tomato, cucumber, red onion.
7. Top third slice.
8. Cut diagonally, secure with toothpick.
9. Serve with side salad.

description: Quick high-protein shrimp stir fry with garlic butter sauce.
instructions:
1. Peel and devein shrimp, pat completely dry.
2. Season with salt, pepper, paprika.
3. Heat large pan till very hot, add butter and oil.
4. Add shrimp in single layer, cook 2 min each side.
5. Remove shrimp.
6. In same pan: add minced garlic, cook 1 min.
7. Add white wine or stock, reduce.
8. Add red chili flakes, lemon juice.
9. Toss shrimp in sauce with fresh parsley.

description: Light crunchy wraps with spiced turkey — a MyFitnessPal crowd favourite.
instructions:
1. Brown 300g ground turkey in pan with 1 tsp oil.
2. Add minced garlic, grated ginger — cook 2 min.
3. Add: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp hoisin, 1 tsp sesame oil, rice vinegar.
4. Cook till sauce coats turkey (3 min).
5. Add finely diced water chestnuts, green onion.
6. Separate iceberg lettuce into cup shapes.
7. Spoon turkey into each leaf.
8. Drizzle with sriracha.
9. Serve with extra sauce and lime.

description: Mediterranean bowl with grilled chicken, feta, olives and tzatziki.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken: olive oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt.
2. Grill 7 min each side till cooked through.
3. Make tzatziki: Greek yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, dill, lemon.
4. Cook 1 cup bulgur wheat or quinoa.
5. Build bowl: grain base, sliced chicken.
6. Add cucumber, cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives.
7. Crumble feta cheese on top.
8. Dollop tzatziki generously.
9. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle oregano.

description: Nutritious bowl inspired by Japanese teishoku dining.
instructions:
1. Follow miso glaze recipe for salmon.
2. Cook 1 cup Japanese short-grain rice.
3. Season rice: 1 tsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, pinch of salt.
4. Prepare toppings: sliced avocado, edamame, cucumber.
5. Make quick pickled carrots: carrot, rice vinegar, sugar, salt, 20 min.
6. Plate warm rice in bowl.
7. Add glazed salmon piece.
8. Arrange toppings beautifully by color.
9. Drizzle ponzu or soy sauce, sesame seeds.

description: Grilled paneer tikka over fresh salad with mint dressing.
instructions:
1. Cube 200g paneer, marinate 1 hour: yogurt, tikka masala, lemon.
2. Skewer paneer with bell peppers and onion.
3. Grill on hot grill 10 min, turning every 2-3 min.
4. Make mint dressing: yogurt, mint, lemon, garlic, salt.
5. Toss mixed greens with light dressing.
6. Add cucumber, cherry tomato, red onion rings.
7. Place hot paneer tikka skewers on salad.
8. Drizzle extra mint dressing.
9. Sprinkle chaat masala and chat with lemon.

description: Light, soothing clear soup with vegetables and healing spices.
instructions:
1. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in pot.
2. Add ginger, garlic, cook 1 min.
3. Add vegetables: carrot, celery, zucchini, spinach.
4. Stir 2 min.
5. Add 4 cups vegetable stock.
6. Season: soy sauce, black pepper, salt, lemon.
7. Bring to boil, reduce heat.
8. Simmer 10 min.
9. Serve hot with fresh herbs garnish.

description: Bottle gourd cooked with moong dal — light, digestive Indian comfort dinner.
instructions:
1. Peel and cube 1 medium lauki (bottle gourd).
2. Pressure cook moong dal till soft.
3. Heat ghee, add cumin, asafoetida.
4. Add onion, cook 4 min.
5. Add tomato, ginger, turmeric, chili.
6. Add lauki, stir 5 min.
7. Add cooked moong dal and water.
8. Simmer 15 min together till all tender.
9. Season with salt, garnish coriander.

description: Flaky whole wheat flatbread with fenugreek and ajwain — nutritious dinner.
instructions:
1. Mix 2 cups whole wheat flour, 1 cup methi leaves.
2. Add ajwain, chili powder, salt, oil.
3. Knead with water to smooth dough.
4. Rest 20 min.
5. Roll into thin circles, fold in thirds twice.
6. Roll again to create layers.
7. Cook on hot tawa with ghee till brown spots appear.
8. For raita: yogurt, cucumber, cumin, salt, coriander.
9. Serve hot parathas with cool raita.

description: Juicy paneer cubes marinated in spices and grilled to smoky perfection.
instructions:
1. Cube 250g paneer into 3cm pieces.
2. Make marinade: hung curd, ginger-garlic, tandoori masala, oil, lemon.
3. Marinate paneer minimum 2 hours.
4. Skewer with bell peppers and onion chunks.
5. Brush grill with oil, heat to high.
6. Grill kebabs 12-15 min, turning every 3 min.
7. Should have good char marks.
8. Serve on bed of onion rings.
9. Squeeze lemon, sprinkle chaat masala.

description: Simple, nutritious side dish — roasted broccoli is a superfood upgrade.
instructions:
1. Cut broccoli into even medium florets.
2. Toss with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, black pepper.
3. Spread in single layer on baking sheet — do not crowd.
4. Roast at 220°C for 20 min.
5. Should have crispy, slightly charred tips.
6. Remove from oven.
7. Squeeze fresh lemon juice.
8. Add parmesan shavings if desired.
9. Serve as side dish with main protein.

description: Fragrant coconut-lemongrass soup with vegetables and tofu.
instructions:
1. Saute garlic, ginger, lemongrass in coconut oil.
2. Add 1-2 tsp Thai green curry paste, cook 2 min.
3. Pour 1 can coconut milk and 2 cups vegetable stock.
4. Add vegetables: mushroom, baby corn, bok choy.
5. Season: fish sauce (or soy), lime juice, palm sugar.
6. Add cubed firm tofu for protein.
7. Simmer 15 min.
8. Taste and adjust — should be creamy, tangy, spicy.
9. Garnish fresh basil, sliced chili, lime wedge.

description: Gentle, detoxifying moong dal soup — best dinner for clean eating days.
instructions:
1. Rinse 1 cup split yellow moong till water runs clear.
2. Boil 4 cups water.
3. Add moong, cook uncovered 20 min till completely soft.
4. Skim any foam that rises.
5. Heat ghee, add cumin, turmeric, asafoetida.
6. Add chopped ginger, green chili.
7. Pour tadka over dal.
8. Add lemon juice, salt.
9. Thin with warm water if needed. Serve piping hot.

description: Elegant, nutrition-dense asparagus roasted with garlic — a superfood side.
instructions:
1. Trim woody ends of asparagus by snapping naturally.
2. Toss in olive oil, minced garlic, salt, pepper, thyme.
3. Spread in tight single layer on baking sheet.
4. Roast at 220°C for 12-15 min.
5. Toss halfway through.
6. Tips should be slightly crispy, stalks tender.
7. Remove from oven, immediately squeeze lemon.
8. Add parmesan shavings.
9. Serve immediately.

description: Naturally sweet, fiber-rich mash with warming spices.
instructions:
1. Peel and cube 3 large sweet potatoes.
2. Boil in salted water till fork-tender (20 min).
3. Drain completely, mash while still hot.
4. Add 2 tbsp butter and 1/4 cup warm milk.
5. Beat with wooden spoon till smooth.
6. Add salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, pinch of ginger.
7. Taste and adjust sweetness.
8. Transfer to serving bowl.
9. Top with toasted pecans and fresh thyme.

description: Healthy whole grain rotis — backbone of any Indian meal.
instructions:
1. Sift 2 cups whole wheat atta into bowl.
2. Add 1 tsp oil, pinch of salt.
3. Add warm water gradually, knead 8-10 min till soft elastic dough.
4. Cover with damp cloth, rest 20-30 min.
5. Divide into 8-10 equal balls.
6. On floured board, roll each into thin 15cm circle.
7. Heat tawa till very hot.
8. Cook each roti 1 min, flip, press edges with cloth.
9. Apply ghee immediately, serve hot.

description: Rich, healing chicken soup with vegetables and whole spices.
instructions:
1. Boil whole chicken pieces with onion, ginger, garlic, celery.
2. Skim foam, simmer 45 min.
3. Remove chicken, shred meat.
4. Strain broth, return to pot.
5. Add vegetables: carrot, celery, peas.
6. Season: black pepper, coriander, cumin, salt.
7. Add shredded chicken back.
8. Simmer 15 min more.
9. Garnish coriander, serve with crusty bread.

description: Indian-spiced scrambled eggs — a quick high-protein dinner.
instructions:
1. Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds.
2. Add finely chopped onion, cook 4 min.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste, green chili.
4. Add tomato, cook 4 min till soft.
5. Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala.
6. Break 4-5 eggs directly into pan.
7. Stir continuously on medium heat, cooking eggs.
8. Add salt, mix well.
9. Garnish coriander, serve with toast or rotis.

description: Restaurant-style garlicky shrimp ready in under 15 minutes.
instructions:
1. Devein 300g large shrimp, keep tails on.
2. Season with salt, pepper, smoked paprika.
3. Heat pan till very hot, add butter and olive oil.
4. Add shrimp in single layer — do not overcrowd.
5. Cook exactly 2 min per side.
6. Remove shrimp, add 6 cloves minced garlic to pan.
7. Saute 1 min, add white wine, reduce.
8. Add shrimp back, lemon juice, parsley.
9. Serve over pasta, rice, or zucchini noodles.

description: Italian baked egg white dish — low-calorie, high-protein, elegant.
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C.
2. Whisk 8 egg whites with salt, pepper, Italian herbs.
3. Saute: spinach, mushroom, sun-dried tomatoes, bell pepper in olive oil.
4. Pour egg whites over vegetables in oven-safe pan.
5. Sprinkle feta or goat cheese crumbles.
6. Cook on stovetop 3 min — edges should just set.
7. Transfer to oven, bake 15-18 min till center is firm.
8. Cool 5 min before slicing.
9. Slice like pizza, serve warm or at room temperature.

description: Make-ahead breakfast loaded with protein from whey and Greek yogurt.
instructions:
1. In a jar: add 1/2 cup rolled oats.
2. Add 1 scoop vanilla whey protein, mix with oats.
3. Add 3 tbsp Greek yogurt.
4. Pour 3/4 cup milk (or almond milk).
5. Add 1 tsp chia seeds, pinch of cinnamon.
6. Stir everything together.
7. Top with fresh berries.
8. Cover and refrigerate overnight (minimum 6 hours).
9. Add toppings and eat cold.

description: Juicy chicken thighs braised with garlic, herbs, and white wine.
instructions:
1. Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, smoked paprika.
2. Sear skin-side down in oven-safe pan 8 min till golden.
3. Flip, sear 3 min.
4. Remove chicken, saute 8 garlic cloves in same fat.
5. Add fresh thyme, rosemary, white wine or stock.
6. Scrape up brown bits — this is flavour.
7. Add chicken back, skin-side up.
8. Bake uncovered at 180°C for 35 min.
9. Baste with pan juices, serve with roasted vegetables.

description: Batch-prep protein oats for 5 weekday breakfasts.
instructions:
1. Prepare 5 jars for the week.
2. Mix: 1/2 cup oats, 1 scoop protein powder.
3. Add 3 tbsp Greek yogurt per jar.
4. Pour almond milk, stir.
5. Add different toppings: berries, banana, mango.
6. Seal, refrigerate up to 5 days.
7. Grab and go each morning.

description: Antioxidant-rich dark chocolate with mixed nuts — healthy indulgence.
instructions:
1. Melt 100g 70%+ dark chocolate in double boiler or microwave.
2. Pour onto parchment-lined tray.
3. Spread thin with offset spatula.
4. Immediately top: chopped almonds, walnuts, pumpkin seeds.
5. Add dried cranberries or blueberries.
6. Sprinkle flaky sea salt.
7. Refrigerate 30-45 min till completely set.
8. Break into irregular rustic pieces.
9. Store airtight in fridge up to 2 weeks.

description: Creamy, thick mango lassi — the ultimate Indian summer drink.
instructions:
1. Blend 1 large ripe alphonso mango (peeled and cubed).
2. Add 1 cup full-fat Greek yogurt.
3. Add 1/2 cup cold whole milk.
4. Add 2 tsp sugar or 1 tsp honey (taste first).
5. Add pinch each: cardamom, saffron.
6. Blend on high till completely smooth.
7. Taste and adjust sweetness.
8. Pour over ice cubes in tall glass.
9. Garnish mango slice, rose water, saffron strands.

description: Crunchy peanut butter granola better than any store version.
instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 170°C.
2. Mix: 3 cups oats, 1/2 cup peanut butter.
3. Add: 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp coconut oil, 1 tsp vanilla.
4. Add: 1/2 cup mixed chopped nuts (almonds, cashews).
5. Add salt, cinnamon — mix very thoroughly.
6. Spread on lined baking sheet, press firmly (creates clusters).
7. Bake 20 min, stir at 10 min carefully.
8. Cool COMPLETELY before touching — this creates crunch.
9. Break into clusters, add dried fruits, store airtight.

description: Cooking brown rice perfectly — the foundation of healthy meal prep.
instructions:
1. Rinse brown rice 3 times till water runs clear.
2. Optional: soak 30 min for faster cooking.
3. Use ratio: 1 cup rice to 2.5 cups cold water.
4. Add pinch of salt, bring to rolling boil.
5. Reduce to absolute lowest heat, cover tightly.
6. Cook undisturbed exactly 40 min.
7. Remove from heat, keep covered 10 min.
8. Fluff with fork gently.
9. Freeze in portions for easy meal prep.

description: High-protein bowl with anti-inflammatory turmeric and fresh toppings.
instructions:
1. Scoop 200g fresh cottage cheese into bowl.
2. Drizzle 1 tsp extra virgin olive oil.
3. Sprinkle: turmeric, black pepper (activates curcumin), salt.
4. Add sliced cucumber, cherry tomatoes.
5. Add sliced radish, spring onion.
6. Add fresh herbs: mint or dill.
7. Drizzle honey if serving as sweet version with fruits.
8. Sprinkle toasted seeds for texture.
9. Best served immediately, with toast on side.

description: Rich, indulgent 3-egg omelette for weight gain phase.
instructions:
1. Crack 3 large whole eggs, whisk well.
2. Add 1 tbsp cream, salt, pepper, herbs.
3. Grate: cheddar, mozzarella, and parmesan ready.
4. Heat butter in pan, add egg mixture.
5. Gently push cooked edges toward center.
6. When 80% set, add all 3 cheeses to one half.
7. Fold over, press gently.
8. Slide onto plate.
9. Top with fresh tomato salsa, serve with 2 toast.

description: Authentic tandoori chicken tikka with classic marinade.
instructions:
1. Cut chicken breast into large cubes.
2. First marinade (30 min): raw papaya paste, lemon, salt.
3. Second marinade (2-4 hours): hung curd, ginger-garlic, kashmiri chili, tandoori masala, oil.
4. Skewer on metal skewers.
5. Cook in preheated 250°C oven or over charcoal grill.
6. Cook 15-20 min, turning every 5 min.
7. Brush with butter while cooking.
8. Should have slight char.
9. Serve with mint chutney, onion rings, lemon.

description: Quick, portable protein wrap with omega-3 rich tuna salad.
instructions:
1. Drain 1 can tuna well.
2. Mix: tuna, 1 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon, lemon, celery.
3. Add sweet relish, salt, pepper.
4. Warm large whole wheat tortilla.
5. Spread tuna mixture down center.
6. Add: romaine, tomato, cucumber, avocado slices.
7. Fold sides in, roll tightly from bottom.
8. Cut diagonally — secure with toothpick if needed.
9. Wrap in parchment for easy transport.

description: Protein-rich egg salad bowl with avocado and mixed greens.
instructions:
1. Hard boil 4 eggs (10 min), cool in ice water, peel.
2. Chop eggs roughly.
3. Make dressing: 1 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon, lemon, salt, dill.
4. Mix eggs with dressing.
5. Serve over bed of mixed greens.
6. Add avocado slices.
7. Add cherry tomatoes, cucumber.
8. Season with salt, pepper, paprika.
9. Drizzle extra lemon juice.

description: Healing, restorative light chicken soup — minimal calories, maximum comfort.
instructions:
1. Place chicken bones/carcass in pot with 6 cups water.
2. Add: halved onion, ginger slices, garlic, celery, carrot.
3. Bring to boil, skim foam.
4. Reduce heat, simmer 1.5 hours.
5. Strain broth completely.
6. Return clear broth to pot, bring to simmer.
7. Add julienned carrot, sliced mushroom, bok choy.
8. Season: soy sauce, salt, white pepper, sesame oil.
9. Add thin noodles if desired, serve hot.

description: Elegant protein salad with poached prawns and Marie Rose sauce.
instructions:
1. Bring water to boil with lemon, peppercorns, bay leaf.
2. Poach 300g prawns 3-4 min till pink.
3. Cool in ice water immediately.
4. Make Marie Rose sauce: mayo, ketchup, Worcestershire, lemon, paprika.
5. Line bowl with iceberg lettuce shreds.
6. Add prawns, avocado cubes, cucumber.
7. Drizzle sauce generously.
8. Dust with paprika.
9. Garnish lemon wedge, serve chilled.

description: Fast-absorbing post-workout shake with whey, banana, and oats.
instructions:
1. Add 1 cup cold milk or almond milk to blender.
2. Add 1 scoop vanilla whey protein powder.
3. Add 1 frozen banana (frozen = creamier).
4. Add 3 tbsp rolled oats.
5. Add 1 tbsp peanut butter.
6. Add 5 ice cubes.
7. Blend on high 60 seconds till completely smooth.
8. Taste — add honey if needed.
9. Drink within 30 min of workout.

description: Simple, protein-dense snack with live cultures and natural sweetness.
instructions:
1. Scoop 200g thick Greek yogurt into bowl.
2. Drizzle 1-2 tsp raw honey on top.
3. Add 1/4 tsp vanilla extract.
4. Add pinch of cinnamon.
5. Top with fresh berries: blueberry, strawberry, raspberry.
6. Add 1 tbsp granola for crunch.
7. Add 5-6 walnut halves.
8. Optional: chia seeds for extra fiber.
9. Serve immediately.
